name: Create Event
description: Create an event in a Google Calendar. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/insert)

configurable_props.name: calendarId
configurable_props.label: Calendar ID
configurable_props.description: Optionally select the calendar, defaults to the primary calendar for the logged-in user

configurable_props.name: summary
configurable_props.label: Event Title
configurable_props.description: Enter a title for the event, (e.g., `My event`)

configurable_props.name: eventStartDate
configurable_props.label: Event Start Date
configurable_props.description: For all-day events, enter the date in the format `yyyy-mm-dd` (e.g., `2025-01-15`). For events with time, format according to [RFC3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-1): `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss+01:00` (e.g., `2025-01-15T10:00:00-05:00`). A time zone offset is required unless a time zone is explicitly specified in timeZone.

configurable_props.name: eventEndDate
configurable_props.label: Event End Date
configurable_props.description: For all-day events, enter the date in the format `yyyy-mm-dd` (e.g., `2025-01-15`). For events with time, format according to [RFC3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-1): `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss+01:00` (e.g., `2025-01-15T11:00:00-05:00`). A time zone offset is required unless a time zone is explicitly specified in timeZone.

configurable_props.name: location
configurable_props.label: Event Location
configurable_props.description: Specify the location of the event

configurable_props.name: description
configurable_props.label: Event Description
configurable_props.description: Enter a description for the event

configurable_props.name: colorId
configurable_props.label: Color ID
configurable_props.description: The color assigned to this event on your calendar. You can only select a color from the list of event colors provided from your calendar. This setting will only affect your calendar.

configurable_props.name: timeZone
configurable_props.label: Time Zone
configurable_props.description: Time zone used in the response. Optional. The default is the time zone of the calendar.

configurable_props.name: sendUpdates
configurable_props.label: Send Updates
configurable_props.description: Configure whether to send notifications about the event

configurable_props.name: createMeetRoom
configurable_props.label: Create Meet Room
configurable_props.description: Whether to create a Google Meet room for this event.

configurable_props.name: repeatFrequency
configurable_props.label: Repeat Frequency
configurable_props.description: Select a frequency to make this event repeating
